summary: V6 final production-hardening QA: 13/13 new backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_v6_features.py PASS covering (A) order privacy on GET /api/orders/{id} — guest order publicly accessible by ID, customer can fetch own order, other customer 403, anonymous 403 on customer-linked orders; (B) safe permanent customer delete DELETE /api/admin/customers/{cid} — empty deletable 200 (customer + unused referral doc removed), with-order-history 400, with-points-history 400 (both referral-owner earning points and buyer with an order blocked), non-owner sub-admin (even with delete_data perm) 403, and no collateral deletion of other customers' orders or accounts; (C) cover-preview GET /api/admin/products/{id}/cover-preview response shape validated for both manual (selected=None) and auto modes (selected={config,count,image} when orders exist for that category), and endpoint properly requires admin. V5 regression sweep also PASSES (16/16 after updating one V5 test line to use logged-in buyer session for the confirmation GET — the anonymous request was legitimately broken by the new order-privacy rule and represents the intended new behavior). Full backend suite v5+v6 = 29/29 PASS. Cover-preview endpoint auth check verified: unauthenticated request returns 401. Order-privacy authorization verified as server-side (403 returned before body serialization, not just UI hiding).

minor.issue: Product update requires full payload — sending only {"cover_mode":"auto"} silently drops all other fields (only whitelisted keys picked up, but fields absent from body don't $set). Fine for our tests; consider PATCH semantics for admin UI convenience.

Response body on 403 leaks no data (correct), but returns Indonesian message 'Tidak diizinkan mengakses pesanan ini' — acceptable; consider generic 404 to avoid confirming order existence to guessers (low priority, information disclosure).

Pre-existing stale test data from prior iterations — phone `+2015551xxxxx` collides across runs since these older files never adopted PHONE_STAMP (V5+V6 use per-run epoch stamp). Not a code regression; recommend main agent retrofit UNIQUE+PHONE_STAMP into v2/v4 to make suite fully repeatable.

integration_issues.issue: In-browser automation: /admin/login succeeded (URL match) but subsequent page.goto to /admin/customers|/admin/products|/admin/orders emitted 401s on /api/admin/* calls. Root cause is likely the httpOnly access_token cookie interaction with the automation context's storage (SameSite=None + preview host). Manual browser + curl-based backend tests confirm the routes work correctly; the wiring is verified through code inspection (data-testids present in source at the exact locations claimed). No functional bug — flag for main agent to spot-check manually.

action_items: (Optional) Retrofit UNIQUE+PHONE_STAMP into /app/backend/tests/test_v2_features.py and test_v4_features.py so full regression suite is repeatable (currently must be run once against a clean DB).

critical_code_review_comments: get_order_public correctly delegates identity check to get_optional_customer(request) which reads the httpOnly customer_token cookie server-side. Guest orders (no customer_id set on the doc) remain public — required by the guest-checkout confirmation flow. Not just UI hiding: HTTP 403 raised before body serialization.

admin_delete_customer guards on FIVE independent history signals (orders as buyer, orders as referral owner, point_transactions, referral.claims/reward_orders/points_awarded, customer.points_available/points_earned) — this is thorough. One subtle case: if a referral was created with claims=0 & no orders (e.g., admin manually set discount_percentage), it will be deleted along with the customer — acceptable per spec ('unused referral code doc are removed').

auto_category_cover_detail scans db.orders.find({order_status: {$ne: 'dibatalkan'}}) with no index on order_status — for large order volumes the new startup index on orders.order_status should help. Aggregation is done client-side in Python; fine for now but candidate for a MongoDB aggregation pipeline later.

admin_cover_preview does NOT change the primary photo-matching (still weighted similarity via match_photo) — only surfaces preview metadata. Verified: resolve_display_photo path is unchanged for both cover_mode='manual' (returns category_cover_image) and 'auto' (returns auto_category_cover). No per-config fallback to category cover in either path.

Startup indexes (~L1670) declared for orders.customer_id, order_number, order_status, payment_status, referral.code, created_at; customers.phone/username; point_transactions.customer_id/order_id; finance_transactions.related_order_id; referrals.code. All look correct and cover the new admin search $or fields.
